messages:
Alex C: Heads up — starterkit sample app hitting a weird parity issue between TS + Py SDKs when using structured output + function invocation. Seems to happen only when auth retry kicks in.
Maria S: ugh can you paste the failure?
Alex C: error from the runtime: 

ci-bot: [build] sample-app-tests (linux) failed — see logs at https://ci.redwood/s/1234

Alex C: stack snippet: 
```
ValidationError: payload did not match schema at path .result
  payload: '{"id":1,"result":{"status":"ok"}}\n'
  parse_error: unexpected token at end of JSON
```

Samir P: that payload looks fine? extra newline? any sanitizer on the TS side?
Priya K: I repro'd. TS helper (sdk/helpers/formatResult.ts) is trimming "\n" but also calling JSON.stringify twice in the retry path. On retry the Authorization header gets re-signed, but we end up with a double-encoded body in the function call variant. Server-side strict schema validator fails on the double-encoded string.
Alex C: exact repro: call -> 401 transient -> SDK retry wrapper re-sends but wraps body as `JSON.stringify(body)` even if body already serialized by json-mode helper.
Maria S: so two issues: (1) retry wrapper shouldn't re-stringify if content-type is application/json and body is already string; (2) auth signer needs the canonical body used for signature — double encode breaks HMAC.
Samir P: agree. quick patch idea: in retry logic, check typeof body === 'string' && headers['content-type']?.startsWith('application/json') then send as-is. also compute signature over raw bytes instead of JSON string to match py.
Priya K: +1. But we also have streaming/path where json-mode helper appends a newline suffix for delimiter — need to avoid trimming that in the validator. maybe validator should allow trailing whitespace?
Maria S: we shouldn't relax validators broadly. Better to make SDKs consistent. Py SDK currently sets bodyBuffer = bytes(json_str + '\n') and signs that. TS is signing json_str (no newline) which is mismatch. Then retry path double-stringifies to '"{...}\n"' and then signs different bytes.
Alex C: ok action items:
- Priya: fix TS retry wrapper to stop double stringify and preserve existing body bytes for signing
- Samir: add explicit unit tests for signature parity with reference Py helper (use same canonicalization)
- Maria: add an e2e sample that exercises a transient 401 and asserts final successful parse + schema validation

Priya K: I'll open a PR tonight. small patch: 
```
// in retry.ts
const payloadToSend = (typeof opts.body === 'string' || opts.body instanceof Buffer) ? opts.body : JSON.stringify(opts.body)
// reuse payloadToSend for signing
```
Samir P: also add an assert in helper that content-type is set — we had cases where it defaulted to multipart/form-data and then stringify made it invalid.
Maria S: sample app patch idea: add a fake auth proxy in tests that returns 401 first time, then 200 and verifies received raw body equals expected bytes (including newline).
Alex C: sounds good. one more edge: function-calling helpers sometimes coerce objects into arrays when multiple tools are present; that combined with stringify double-encode produced an array-of-string that the schema rejects. keep an eye on that.
Priya K: noted. Will include extra test for function-call payload shape.

ci-bot: PR #4823 opened by priya-k: "ts: fix retry double-encode + signing parity with py sdk" — https://ci.redwood/p/4823
Alex C: thanks! once merged let's roll sample-app CI to confirm. :rocket:
Maria S: can someone add a short note to the SDK migration guide about "do not manually re-serialize body if already serialized by json-mode helper"? New users keep stumbling here.
Samir P: I'll do that in the devex docs.
Priya K: ping me for review if you add code snippets; I'll include a minimal repro script.
Alex C: closing loop: file name for the sample patch: sample-app/tests/auth-retry-parity.test.ts — verify schema.validate(Buffer.from(received)).
Maria S: nice. thanks team. :thumbsup:
